header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner; nor intimation received.
body: This petition was filed in year 2019 with the prayer to issue writ of qou-warranto against respondents No.10 to 14. Since fresh appointment has been made on posts advertised in year 2019, when this petition was filed; hence instant petition has become infructuous, therefore, same is hereby dismissed alongwith listed pending application.
